STEP 4 - Speed Ramp: implemented as a tail slow-mo (last 0.6s at 0.5x) applied to BOTH video (head/tail split + setpts/concat) and audio (atrim split + atempo/concat) so A/V stays in sync. Not a smooth bezier ramp; constant-rate tail only.

CUT GRID (2026-10-12): plan_kills now derives slots ONLY from the beat grid - pre-drop slot = 2 beats (1.293s), in-drop slot = 1 beat (0.647s); cut times are exactly grid beats (15/15 within 0.0ms in the 92.79 BPM test). Speed ramp is now length-preserving (normal-speed onset hold + sped-up mid + slow-mo tail) so out_duration == duration; slot length never changes. Removed hardcoded fade-to-black; flash replaced by eq brightness +0.10 pulse (bloom) targeting 1.15-1.8x.
STEP 4 - Flash: single white flash (2 frames, ~0.033s) overlaid at each kill clip start; global grade tints it to ~luma 215 (not pure 255).
STEP 5 - Text verification: ASS timestamp alignment fixed in conductor.py (shifted by project.music_start). Original code had absolute audio timestamps instead of relative to video start.
STEP 6 - Kill-feed detection (OCR of top-right feed on raw clips) not yet implemented; overlays and SFX are done.

STEP 6 - Overlays: black-background clips keyed with colorkey=0x000000:0.18:0.05 (no native alpha in source files), alpha-scaled to 0.9, windowed 0.6-0.7s at each kill start via overlay enable=between().
